dz: 在吉尔多出兵后吉尔多的叛乱被忠于西罗马皇帝霍诺利乌斯的势力所击败,在吉尔多的弟弟马斯塞泽尔和吉尔多随后的去世下结束.
de: End of the Gildonic rebellion after Gildo's forces are defeated by forces loyal to Western Roman Emperor Honorius under Gildo's brother Mascezel and Gildo's subsequent death.
